# goslop text fixture — typed pass-through then generic wrap into same domain
# error (Project_Parva rulelang_service.py FP shape)
lang: python
file: rulelang_service.py
---
class RuleLangError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, msg, code=None):
        self.code = code

def call_function(function, context, args):
    try:
        outcome = function(context, args)
    except RuleLangError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuleLangError(str(exc), code="RULE_EXECUTION_FAILED") from exc
    return outcome
